parts:
Hello Dr. van Hees,

I’m a doctoral student at University of Southern California and am currently working on processing some GENEActiv data using GGIR. I’m interested in the prospective within-day relationship between MVPA predicting momentary stress. Momentary stress was measured via smartphone survey 4 times per day in a semi-random fashion (i.e., the time that each survey was sent differed slightly across days), for 14 days. Participants were asked to respond to the survey as soon as they noticed they’d received it and it was safe to do so (i.e., the timing of each survey response differed across participants within a day). I want to decompose day-level data into 4 segments, where each segment is specific to the time where each participant on each day responded to each of the four prompts.

I’ve been using the newest version of R via: 

When I run all parts (1-5) in R, it goes smoothly without any errors. Here is a screenshot of the first 3 days of my activity log CSV file for all my participants (N=30):

However, when I inspect the output in part 2, I am missing the CSV file called “part2_daysummary_longformat”. When I click into the “part2_daysummary” CSV file, there are only 24 h (day-level) segments available. I’ve attached my code below as R file "Code 1." 

Next, I tried re-running part 2 (code attached below as R file Code 2). Again, no errors and output is produced easily. This time, there is a CSV file called “part2_daysummary_longformat”—but when I inspect both this and the “part2_daysummary” file, I again see only segments using 0-24 h. For example, in the file "part2_daysummary_longformat," the variable 'qwindow_timestamps' has a value of 00:00-24:00 and qwindow_name is 'daystart-dayend' for all days, and all variables are aggregated at the daily level.

I thought that maybe I was asking too much of the qwindow segmentation, since n=30 participants all have differently sized segments from each other and for each day. So, I tried creating a new activity log, imputing the time that each survey was SENT rather than the time each survey was RESPONDED to (see below screenshot for all participants for first 3 days). 
 
I tried re-running part 2, did not encounter any errors, but was met with the same result (only day-level window, not within-day segments as specified in the activity log).

Could you help me determine how to proceed from here? I’ve attached all relevant files below.

Thanks so much,

Rachel Crosley-Lyons
